observations: Black ergonomic office chair with a curved mesh back and a separate, curved footrest.
Silver five-star base with black casters.
Adjustable armrests with black plastic caps.
The chair is positioned in a living room setting with a grey sofa and a dark wood TV stand.
The mesh material on the back and seat appears to be intact but shows some minor surface wear or discoloration.

risks.proof: A close-up photo of the mesh texture and edges.

risks.risk: The armrests may be loose or the headrest may be missing.
risks.proof: A photo of the armrests and headrest in the upright position.

Close-up photo of the mesh material to check for tears or thinning.

response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
